summary: T-REX Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K announcing its wholly owned subsidiary, M M E 2, LLC, entered into a definitive Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire an operating 3-megawatt turnkey data center in Roberta, Georgia, from Cryptaugh LLC and Sonace LLC. Assets include a 5.8-acre parcel, six portable mining containers, and an electrical services contract with Flint Electric Membership Corporation supplying up to 4.5 megawatts. No purchase price or premium is disclosed. The acquisition aligns with the company's crypto-mining expansion, expected to close on or before May 25, 2026. Watch for disclosure of consideration and regulatory filings.
